description: "Hi! We are SpatialBytes—Ahmad, Sibga, and Fiza. As a team, we bring a strong, combined background in GIS, Remote Sensing, and spatial analysis. We are tackling the 'Field Shift' challenge by transforming NASA open data into a practical decision-support tool. By combining Earth observations with local data, we aim to help farmers optimize crop rotations, adapt to climate changes, and protect soil health. We're ready to turn complex spatial data into real-world solutions!"
summary: SpatialBytes — D.G. Khan Climate & Crop Advisory is an open-access, farmer-first GIS decision-support web dashboard built for smallholder farmers in Dera Ghazi Khan District, Punjab, Pakistan. By harmonizing multi-sensor NASA Earth observations (Landsat 9, MODIS Terra, SMAP Level-4, and GPM IMERG V07) from 2010–2025 onto a 30m grid, the platform translates complex satellite stress metrics into a simple Red–Yellow–Green traffic-light crop rotation advisory paired with one-tap English voice readouts and localized Urdu MP3 audio.
details:
THE LOCAL CHALLENGE

Smallholder farmers in Dera Ghazi Khan District (Punjab, Pakistan) face intensifying summer heatwaves (31°C–32°C Land Surface Temperature), erratic rainfall, and declining root-zone soil moisture. Multi-year satellite analysis (2010–2025) shows rising thermal stress and post-2020 vegetation decline (mean NDVI dropping from 0.28 to 0.272), causing traditional water-intensive Wheat–Cotton cropping systems to fail and threatening rural livelihoods. Because raw satellite datasets are too technical for local farmers, there is an urgent need for simple, localized, actionable decision-support tools.

HUMAN-LED METHODOLOGY & NASA DATA HARMONIZATION

Team SpatialBytes (Ahmad Ali, Sibga Mehboob, and Fiza Shafique) integrated four core NASA Earth observation datasets through a 5-step geospatial workflow:

1. Data Extraction in Google Earth Engine (GEE): Extracted Landsat 9 (30m NDVI), MODIS Terra (MOD11A2 Land Surface Temperature & MOD13Q1 5-year NDVI shift), SMAP Level-4 (root-zone soil moisture in m³/m³), and GPM IMERG V07 (annual precipitation in mm).

2. Spatial Harmonization: Resampled and reprojected all multi-sensor rasters onto a common 30-meter analysis grid.

3. Administrative Clipping in QGIS: Clipped harmonized layers to Dera Ghazi Khan's four tehsils (Tribal Area, D.G. Khan, Kot Chatta, and Taunsa) using HDX Pakistan Administrative Boundaries.

4. Zonal Statistics: Computed tehsil-level mean NDVI, LST, soil moisture, rainfall, and 2020–2025 vegetation shift metrics (e.g., identifying -0.0105 NDVI decline and 0.1479 m³/m³ soil moisture stress in Taunsa).

5. Vulnerability Index & Web Deployment: Built an interactive Leaflet web dashboard via QGIS and qgis2web, hosted publicly on GitHub Pages.

ACTIONABLE FARMER INSIGHTS: 3-TIER CROP ROTATION STRATEGY

Our dashboard translates satellite risk levels into a clear Red–Yellow–Green traffic-light advisory:

- Strategy 1 — Current Practice / High Risk (Wheat–Cotton): Flagged as high-risk due to extreme irrigation demand and heat vulnerability; viable only in monitored canal zones with heat-alert irrigation.

- Strategy 2 — Drought & Heat Resilience (Wheat–Sorghum / Pearl Millet): Recommended for Red-signal arid zones (such as D.G. Khan Tribal Area) to cut summer irrigation requirements.

- Strategy 3 — Soil Health & Regeneration (Wheat–Legumes): Recommended for Yellow-signal zones (such as Kot Chatta and Taunsa) to fix soil nitrogen and retain root-zone moisture.

Each advisory is paired with practical field guidance (mulching and deficit irrigation), clutter-free tehsil pop-ups, an interactive NASA Data Legend, and one-tap English voice + localized Urdu MP3 advisories.

USE OF SUPER INTELLIGENCE (SI) & TRANSPARENCY STATEMENT

All geospatial modeling, NASA data harmonization, zonal statistics, and crop rotation strategies were independently designed and verified by Team SpatialBytes (Ahmad Ali, Sibga Mehboob, Fiza Shafique). Super Intelligence (SI) tools were used strictly as support assistants—specifically narakeet.com for generating clear Pakistani Urdu and English MP3 voice advisories for local farmers, and AI coding assistants for GEE/JavaScript syntax optimization and documentation formatting.
